description: This source file defines a SwiftUI View component 'OpenClawChatComposer' responsible for composing and sending chat messages. It includes UI elements such as toolbars, pickers, message input area, and attachment handling with platform-specific implementations for macOS and other OSes.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: Custom NSTextView subclass to handle key events and paste operations, including support for image pasting and sending messages via Return key.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: Utility enum providing static methods for handling image attachments and file URLs from pasteboard, supporting different image formats and file types.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates a coordinator object to serve as delegate for NSTextView, coordinating text change events and send actions.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures the NSScrollView containing the custom NSTextView for text input.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView to reflect the current text and focus state.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens a macOS NSOpenPanel to select image files for attachments.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles dropped files over the chat composer on macOS, adding selected files as attachments.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads selected photos from the photo picker asynchronously and adds them as attachments.
